comparison.objective: Attach a grounding set in the mandated ground-first order and tighten both clamps; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Hang and torque two stick-operated clamps in a safety-critical sequence versus bimanually level and latch a rail at two rack posts, telescope it, and drive screws.
comparison.success_condition: Requires no contact with forbidden bars, ground-first completion, minimum clamp force/torque, release, and tug retention; candidate requires correct orientation, rack-unit match, full spring engagement, bottom screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both install load-bearing contacts at two sites, but grounding order, forbidden-contact safety, and clamp tightening test a different ability. The candidate lacks comparable numeric fastening and overload thresholds.
